accessDenied.title: Access denied
accessDenied.description: You do not have permission to view this page

shell.title: UGS Admin v2
shell.subtitle: Table-based management of providers, types, and workflows. Bulk edits go through validation.

loadError.title: Failed to load UGS Admin v2

validate.confirmWarnings: You can apply only after confirming warnings.

validation.configJsonMustBeObject: config_json must be a JSON object
validation.baseUrlMustStartWithHttp: base_url must start with http:// or https://
validation.providerRoleTextOnlyForTextTypes: provider_role=text is allowed only for provider_type llama/llama/miso.
validation.defaultModelModelsOnlyForTextTypes: default_model/models are available only for provider_type llama/llama/miso.
validation.configJsonNoModelFieldsForNonText: config_json must not contain default_model/models/provider_role=text for non-text providers.
validation.scanOnlyForTextRole: Model scanning is available only for provider role: text.

overview.quickActionsHint: All operations are validated and require confirmation when warnings are present.

providers.title: Providers
providers.subtitle: Select rows and apply bulk changes.
providers.providerRoleHint: Role controls which fields are visible in the UI (e.g. models only for text).

types.title: Types
types.subtitle: Row click opens full type edit (GenerationTypeUpdate). Bulk edit is a partial patch on the selection; delete is still unavailable.
types.bulkEditSubtitle: Fill only the fields you want to change. Empty fields leave selected rows untouched.
types.editSubtitle: Full type.patch via bulk validate/apply. type_key is immutable. Prefer the Models tab for model routing.
types.modelNameHint: Legacy fallback; runtime usually resolves models from model_routes (Models tab).
types.createSubtitle: Creates a new row via type.create bulk validate/apply.

workflows.title: Workflows
workflows.subtitle: ComfyUI templates. Row click opens the full editor (json_body, metadata, dependencies). Activate/deactivate in bulk.
workflows.editSubtitle: Full workflow.patch via validate/apply. slug is immutable.
workflows.createSubtitle: Creates a new row via workflow.create bulk validate/apply.

models.title: Models and routes
models.subtitle: Models are selected centrally from the DB. Types no longer edit `model_name` directly.
models.recommendationsHint: Select recommendations. Standard bulk-operation validation opens before apply; changes reach the DB only after confirmation.
models.workflowMaterializationHint: Imports ComfyUI JSON templates into the `comfyui_workflows` table. Files remain seed/template; runtime is managed from the DB.
models.discoveryHint: GET /llama-models augments snapshot inventory; DB write uses bulk provider.models.refresh.
models.allowlistHint: Comma-separated model ids allowed for per-request overrides. Patches only request_model_override_allowlist.
models.replaceRoutesHint: Danger: replaces the full DB model_routes document via model_routes.replace. Prefilled from snapshot; validate before apply.

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: CRUD via bulk validate/apply with the same uniqueness rules as legacy /settings.
settings.modalHint: Changes go through settings.create / settings.patch / settings.delete and require bulk apply confirmation.

bootstrap.nothingBody: All runtime seeds are already materialized or skipped.

bulkEditProviders.title: Extended provider bulk edit
bulkEditProviders.subtitle: Fill in only the fields you want to change. Changes go through bulk validate/apply and require confirmation.
bulkEditProviders.legacyModelFieldsTitle: config_json has legacy model fields on non-text providers
bulkEditProviders.legacyModelFieldsHint: You can clean up `default_model`, `models`, and erroneous `provider_role=text` without manual JSON editing.
bulkEditProviders.fallbackForHint: Comma-separated provider_name list. Empty = do not change.
bulkEditProviders.configJsonSectionHint: You can set `default_model`, `models[]`, and/or JSON. merge generates one operation per provider.
bulkEditProviders.scanHint: Available only for provider role text. Scanning lists models and fills the models field. DB write happens only after bulk apply confirmation.
bulkEditProviders.providerRoleHint: Controls which fields to show in the UI (e.g. models only for text).
bulkEditProviders.defaultModelHintText: Updates config_json.default_model. To apply to all provider types, use the button below.
bulkEditProviders.defaultModelHintNonText: Model fields are disabled for role != text.
bulkEditProviders.modelsCsvHint: Comma-separated model list; written to config_json.models
bulkEditProviders.applyModelToAllTypesTitle: Apply model to all provider types
bulkEditProviders.applyModelToAllTypesHint: Sets model_routes.provider_defaults[{{provider}}] and type_overrides for {{count}} types so the model wins over category/domain routes.
